title: Latte Factor Weekly Cost Leak
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| search habit_tag="latte_factor"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(amount) as spend count as purchases by _time merchant_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks latte-factor spending over time and breaks it out by merchant.
value: Weekly spend on routine small treats is the classic leakage pattern that feels invisible one purchase at a time.
implementation: Send latte-factor spending events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of latte-factor spending by merchant.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how latte-factor spending changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
